tokens_hint: Let scripts and tools use your account through the API.
tokens_intro: Send a token in the Authorization header when you call the public API. A token acts as you, never as staff, and only within the permissions you choose. You can revoke it at any time.
tokens_empty: You have no active access tokens.
tokens_limit_reached: You reached the limit of {max} active tokens. Revoke one to create another.
tokens_dialog_text: Choose what the token can do. You will see the secret only once.
tokens_field_name_hint: For example, the tool that will use it.
tokens_scope_read_hint: See your private data, such as your account, follows and notifications, and use read endpoints.
tokens_scope_mods_write_hint: Create and edit your mods, versions and uploads.
tokens_scope_social_write_hint: Post comments and reviews, and follow mods and creators.
tokens_secret_text: This is the only time it is shown. Store it somewhere safe and never share it.
tokens_revoke_text: Anything using “{name}” will stop working immediately.
